questions.question: In discrete-time Kalman filtering for a dynamic system x_{k+1} = A x_k + w_k with measurement z_k = C x_k + v_k (where w_k and v_k are zero-mean white noise processes with covariances Q and R), under what condition is the steady-state error covariance matrix guaranteed to converge to a unique, positive semi-definite solution independent of the initial state covariance?
options: The system dynamic matrix A must be symmetric and strictly diagonally dominant.
The pair (A, C) must be detectable, and the pair (A, Q^(1/2)) must be stabilizable.
The measurement noise covariance R must be strictly equal to zero.
The system matrix A must have all its eigenvalues located strictly on the unit circle.

questions.question: A single line-to-ground (SLG) fault occurs on Phase A of an unloaded three-phase power system. The sequence impedances looking into the fault point are Z_1 = j0.15 p.u., Z_2 = j0.15 p.u., and Z_0 = j0.10 p.u. If the pre-fault line-to-neutral voltage is 1.0 p.u. and the fault impedance is zero, what is the magnitude of the total fault current flowing into the ground?

Consider a ideal parallel-plate capacitor with circular plates of radius R separated by a distance d and filled with a uniform dielectric material of permittivity e and permeability u. A time-varying AC voltage V(t) = V_0 * sin(w * t) is applied across the plates. Using Maxwell's equations, what is the peak amplitude of the induced magnetic field B(r) inside the capacitor at a radial distance r < R from the central axis?

An open-loop transfer function G(s)H(s) of a unity feedback control system has exactly 2 open-loop poles in the right-half s-plane (RHP) and no open-loop zeros in the RHP. For the closed-loop system to be stable, how must the Nyquist plot of G(s)H(s) encircle the critical point (-1, j0)?
options: It must encircle (-1, j0) exactly 2 times in the clockwise direction.
It must encircle (-1, j0) exactly 2 times in the counter-clockwise direction.
It must encircle (-1, j0) exactly 1 time in the counter-clockwise direction.
It must not encircle (-1, j0) at all.

questions.question: An operational amplifier has an open-loop DC voltage gain of 100 dB and a single dominant pole at a frequency of 10 Hz. The op-amp is configured as a non-inverting amplifier with a feedback resistor of 99 kOHm and an input resistor to ground of 1 kOHm. Assuming no parasitic capacitances, what is the closed-loop -3 dB bandwidth of this amplifier circuit?
